description: This file defines a comprehensive framework for creating and managing settings interfaces in a Kivy application, including various panel layouts, setting types, and JSON-based configuration.

classes.name: SettingSpacer
classes.description: Internal class used as a spacer widget within settings popups.

classes.name: SettingItem
classes.description: Base class for individual setting widgets, providing common properties and touch interactions.

classes.name: SettingBoolean
classes.description: Widget for boolean settings, visualized with a Switch.

classes.name: SettingString
classes.description: Widget for string settings, opens a popup with a TextInput for editing.

classes.name: SettingPath
classes.description: Widget for file path settings, opens a file chooser popup.

classes.name: SettingColor
classes.description: Widget for color settings, opens a color picker popup.

classes.name: SettingNumeric
classes.description: Widget for numeric settings, extends SettingString with validation.

classes.name: SettingOptions
classes.description: Widget for selecting from a list of options, opens a popup with toggle buttons.

classes.name: SettingTitle
classes.description: Label widget used as a section title within settings panels.

classes.name: SettingsPanel
classes.description: Container for a group of settings, linked to a ConfigParser.

classes.name: Settings
classes.description: Main class managing the settings UI, panels, and JSON configuration.

classes.name: InterfaceWithSidebar
classes.description: Default interface with a sidebar menu for switching panels.

classes.name: InterfaceWithSpinner
classes.description: Interface with a spinner at the top for switching panels.

classes.name: ContentPanel
classes.description: Widget for displaying a single settings panel, managing panel switching.

classes.name: MenuSidebar
classes.description: Sidebar menu widget with buttons for each settings panel.

classes.name: SettingSidebarLabel
classes.description: Internal label widget for sidebar menu items.

methods.name: add_widget
methods.description: Adds a widget to the settings item or panel.

methods.name: on_touch_down
methods.description: Handles touch down events for visual feedback.

methods.name: on_touch_up
methods.description: Handles touch release events for triggering actions.

methods.name: on_release
methods.description: Event dispatched when a setting item is released.

methods.name: get_value
methods.description: Retrieves the current value of a config section/key.

methods.name: set_value
methods.description: Sets a new value for a config section/key and dispatches change event.

methods.name: add_panel
methods.description: Adds a new settings panel to the interface.

methods.name: add_json_panel
methods.description: Creates and adds a settings panel from a JSON definition.

methods.name: create_json_panel
methods.description: Constructs a SettingsPanel from JSON data.

methods.name: add_kivy_panel
methods.description: Adds a panel for configuring Kivy settings.

methods.name: add_item
methods.description: Adds an item to the sidebar or spinner menu.

methods.name: add_panel
methods.description: Adds a settings panel to the ContentPanel for display.

methods.name: on_current_uid
methods.description: Switches the displayed panel based on UID.

methods.name: add_panel
methods.description: Adds a panel to the internal panels dictionary.

methods.name: on_close
methods.description: Event triggered when the settings interface is closed.
